lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Namaste Aarav, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket-ball jaise 3D shapes ke faces, edges aur corners dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Haan didi, ready hoon.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, socho ek cricket kit ka box: tum batao, uske kaunse flat parts ko faces kahoge?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, box ke flat parts faces hote hain; tum screen par “face” label point karoge?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, yeh matchbox ek cuboid hai; ab tum batao, cuboid ke flat parts ko kya kehte hain?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, matchbox ek cuboid hai. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, har solid shape ke flat parts ko faces kehte hain. Ab card par diye pairs ko dhyaan se dekho. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Didi mujhe cricket bahut pasand hai, main roz khelta hoon.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, cricket tumhe bahut pasand hai—yeh aaj ke maths work se alag hai. Is question ke baad cricket par wapas aayenge. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, Cube shape ke stage prop par teen edges ek point par milti hain. Woh point face, edge ya corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Kyunki maine dhyaan se gina.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Haan, tumne teen edges jahan milti hain, us meeting point ko corner pehchaana. Ab cube par agla corner dhoondo.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Theek hai, Aarav. Cube par ek aur meeting point dekho aur usse mark karo. Cube shape ke stage prop par teen edges ek point par milti hain. Woh point face, edge ya corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Corner.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, tumne kaise jaana ki woh point corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Corner.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Tumne shape ka naam sahi pakda; ab ek corner se nikalti sticks gino. School display ke liye Meera sticks se cube ka frame banati hai. Kisi bhi ek corner par kitni stick-edges milti hain?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Ek edges.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Ek edge tumne dekhi. Ab usi corner se judne wali baaki sticks ko ungli se ek-ek karke trace karo. School display ke liye Meera sticks se cube ka frame banati hai. Kisi bhi ek corner par kitni stick-edges milti hain?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Namaste Aarav! Aaj right angles aur circles ko cricket ke angles aur ball se dekhenge—tum ready ho?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Haan didi, main ready hoon.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Cricket pitch par ball seedhi line se mudti hai; tum batao, 90-degree turn kaisa dikhega? Golu ko bhi sikhaoge.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, “aage batao” se tum seekhna chahte ho; folded paper ka square corner angle par milao—kya dono corners milte hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Aapko yaad hai pichhli baar humne kya kiya tha?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Haan Aarav, aaj hum right angle aur circle dekh rahe hain. Pichhli baar ka topic mujhe yahan dikh nahi raha—tum ek clue doge?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, paper ko half, phir half fold karke square corner banao; window corner mein rakho. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Aap meri saari baatein hamesha yaad rakhogi na?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, main AI hoon; mujhe har baat hamesha yaad nahi rehti. Ab hum apne maths ke kaam par lautte hain. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, paper ke corner ko doosre corner par rakho. Dekho, beech mein khaali jagah bachti hai ya paper overlap karta hai. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Yaad hai maine aapko apne kutte ke baare mein kya bataya tha?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, dog wali baat mujhe exact yaad nahi; use baad mein dekhenge. Kabaddi court par do painted lines jahaan milti hain, wahaan folded paper ka square corner bilkul fit hota hai. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Kyunki maine dhyaan se gina.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, dhyaan se ginna achha step hai. Ab paper ke folded corner ko lines ke milne waali jagah par rakhkar fit check karo. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Jo maine aaj bataya woh bhool jao please.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Kabaddi court par do painted lines jahaan milti hain, wahaan folded paper ka square corner bilkul fit hota hai. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?
